item.title: New Mexico House Passes Low-Income Broadband Subsidy Bill
item.description: The New Mexico House voted 48-14 on Wednesday to adopt SB-152, which would set up a state subsidy program for broadband subscriptions for low-income residents (see [Ref:2602170021]). It was adopted by the Senate last week.

item.description: The 5G Americas board decided to close the industry-sponsored group this month, it said Wednesday. The organization started as 3G Americas, became 4G Americas and adopted its current name 10 years ago with 5G on the horizon (see [Ref:1602120047]). ...
